title: Mark the J02 activation acceptance as a historical record
summary: docs/j02-activation-and-discovery.md recorded one real acceptance run on 2026-09-01 in which a fresh Codex CLI session discovered the assayer:assayer-audit Skill and called start_audit. The file carried no historical marker and its leading section was still titled Current Status, so a reader could take a retired capability and a retired tool name as current guidance even though retire-the-vertical-audit-skill-and-gate-bundle-text removed the audit Skill and the compiled Host exposes a different tool set. The acceptance facts themselves are a truthful record of that execution and are kept for traceability; only the framing changes. This change adds a historical acceptance banner that names the retirement, lists the compiled tools that replaced start_audit, and states that the observations are not current guidance or an active gate, and it retitles the leading section to Recorded status at the 2026-09-01 acceptance. No normative document, gate, contract, workflow, or code path changes, and no record is edited or superseded.

platform: Repository documentation owns the historical framing of a records-only acceptance file
plugin: No plugin change; the retired audit Skill is not restored or re-described as current
agent: No Agent guidance change; Skills already teach the compiled workflow

forbiddenResponsibilities: The change must not delete or rewrite the recorded 2026-09-01 observations, which remain traceability evidence
The change must not present the retired audit Skill or start_audit as a current capability
The change must not touch a normative document, a gate, or a CI workflow
The change must not edit or supersede any existing design record
acceptance: docs/j02-activation-and-discovery.md opens with a historical acceptance banner that names the retired audit Skill and lists the compiled tools that replaced start_audit
the leading status section is no longer titled Current Status
the 2026-09-01 observations are retained unchanged in substance
the design confirmation, document, English text, architecture, plugin-source, and resilience gates all stay green

humanApproval.decision: Internal-only documentation framing change carried out under the standing authorization of the refactor mandate in #assayer-group:4c84ee19 and its delegation update, under which the agent and reviewer decide these changes themselves within at most seven workflow rounds. No normative document, contract, gate, or behaviour changes; the batch adds a historical banner and retitles one section of a records-only acceptance file.
